thought: Takahashi is the main antagonist - a Japanese Imperial Army commander, so he must be visually distinct from all Chinese Eighth Route Army characters. Comparing with others: all Chinese soldiers wear blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniforms, while Takahashi wears Japanese Imperial Army uniform. The most distinctive features would be: 1) A traditional katana (Japanese samurai sword) in its scabbard at his left hip - uniquely Japanese and completely different from any Chinese weapons; 2) Japanese Imperial Army officer uniform in olive-green/khaki with different cut and styling; 3) A thin, trimmed mustache typical of Japanese officers of that era; 4) White officer's gloves. The katana is the primary visual anchor, as it's iconically Japanese and immediately distinguishes him from all Chinese characters. This, combined with the completely different uniform color and style, makes him unmistakable as the Japanese antagonist.
distinctive_features: Traditional katana (Japanese samurai sword) at left hip, Japanese Imperial Army olive-green officer uniform, thin trimmed mustache, white officer's gloves
prompt: Full body portrait of a Japanese Imperial Army commander standing in a rigid, authoritative military stance, embodying arrogance and ruthless command. The man has a stern face with a distinctively thin, neatly trimmed mustache in the style of Japanese officers of the 1940s. Most prominently, a traditional katana (Japanese samurai sword) in an ornate scabbard hangs from his left hip, immediately marking him as a Japanese officer - a weapon completely distinct from Chinese arms. He wears white officer's gloves on both hands, adding to his imperious appearance. His uniform is olive-green Japanese Imperial Army officer's dress with high collar, gold buttons, leather Sam Browne belt crossing diagonally over his chest and around waist supporting the katana, military cap with Imperial Japanese Army insignia (star), olive-green jodhpur-style pants, tall leather riding boots. A holstered pistol sits at his right hip. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored deep crimson red background with high contrast separation, creating an ominous silhouette. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front-right, casting sharp shadows that emphasize the curved katana at his hip, his mustache, the white gloves, and the harsh lines of his face. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation tones - muted olive-greens, dark leather browns, stark white for gloves. The lighting highlights the polished metal fittings of the katana and the leather of the Sam Browne belt. Solemn, menacing, and authoritative atmosphere with an undercurrent of arrogance, reflecting the antagonistic Japanese command presence in 1941 wartime China. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong contrast between light and shadow, emphasizing the harsh, dignified, and epic nature of historical conflict. Deep focus keeping the entire figure sharp from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys imperial arrogance, ruthless authority, and cruel determination. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Japanese Imperial Army officer appearance and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Japanese officer with katana sword, olive uniform, mustache, and white gloves
